title: Convert project to use uv
description:
Replace pip with uv as the default package manager, adopt modern Python tooling, and update all documentation accordingly.

## What needs to change

### pyproject.toml
- Add [build-system] using uv_build (not hatchling — simpler, sufficient for pure Python)
- Bump requires-python to '>=3.13'
- Remove [tool.black] config; replace with [tool.ruff] and [tool.ruff.format]
- Add ruff lint config: select = ["ALL"] with explicit ignores (D, COM812, ISC001 at minimum)
- Add ty config under [tool.ty.environment] python-version = '3.13' and [tool.ty.terminal] error-on-warning = true
- Add [dependency-groups] for dev tools (ruff, ty, pytest, pytest-cov) — NOT [project.optional-dependencies]
- Do NOT pin runtime deps with == (they are user-facing, >= is appropriate); dev group deps can be unpinned
- Add pytest config: [tool.pytest.ini_options] with --cov and --cov-fail-under

### README.md
- Line 44: Replace 'pip install .' with 'uv sync'
- Add uv installation step before clone step (or reference https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)
- Replace Python version mention (3.10+) with 3.13+
- Remove mention of Spotipy/etc. in Requirements section — pyproject.toml is the source of truth; just link there
- Update dev setup docs to use 'uv sync --all-groups' and 'uv run <cmd>' patterns

### Tooling files to add/remove
- Add Makefile with dev/lint/format/test/build targets using 'uv run ...'
- Install prek: run 'prek install' then configure hooks for ruff, ty, shellcheck, detect-secrets (see prek.md)
- Add .python-version file containing '3.13'
- uv.lock already exists — commit it

### Commands to run after pyproject.toml changes
1. uv add --group dev ruff ty pytest pytest-cov
2. uv run ruff check --fix .
3. uv run ruff format .
4. uv run ty check src/
5. prek install

## Anti-patterns to avoid
- Do NOT use 'uv pip install' — use 'uv add' / 'uv sync'
- Do NOT manually activate venv — use 'uv run <cmd>'
- Do NOT use hatchling — use uv_build
- Do NOT use [project.optional-dependencies] for dev tools — use [dependency-groups]
- Do NOT use mypy/pyright — use ty

title: Evaluate and implement playlist generation speedups
description: Profile and evaluate options to speed up playlist generation: threading/async for parallel API calls, smarter caching strategies (cache channel metadata, avoid re-fetching known data), or other mechanisms. Implement whichever approach(es) provide meaningful gains without adding undue complexity.

title: Support channel ID URLs and handle URL formats interchangeably
description: User-facing code should accept any YouTube URL format (channel ID URLs like youtube.com/channel/UCxxxx, handle URLs like youtube.com/@handle, etc.) and normalize them internally to whatever format the backend needs for querying. Users should not need to know or care which URL format to provide.
